final: WITH circuit_avgs AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, AVG(CAST(r.round AS REAL)) as circuit_avg_round FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country), country_avgs AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(CAST(r.round AS REAL)) as country_avg_round FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.circuit_avg_round, ca.circuit_avg_round - cya.country_avg_round as difference FROM circuit_avgs ca JOIN country_avgs cya ON ca.country = cya.country WHERE cya.country_avg_round IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC, ca.circuitId LIMIT 10    -- Returns top 10 circuits by how far above/below their country's average round number they host races
